description: This PHP class defines a controller for generating a 'My Leave Entitlement Report' view component within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to access leave period data, setting up a component with leave period properties for rendering.

classes.name: MyLeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the leave entitlement report view component with current leave period data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting leave period properties based on current leave period data.
